subject: Confirming budget holder + security / procurement contacts for OptiGrid
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@optigrid.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: who signs for budget and security gate?

Claire — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and three asks to keep momentum: 

Recap:
- You have a pilot scope around inference for grid-event summarization and anomaly detection (2 models, ~50k tokens/day).
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 250ms for single-request workflows, cost target <$0.0009/token equivalent, and no external data retention beyond 30 days.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff in late Oct, evaluation through November, decision in early Dec.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer who owns the pilot budget? We want to avoid re-routing later in the process.
2) Please share the security/compliance contact who will own the questionnaire (SOC2 scope / data retention).
3) If there's a procurement contact or standard SOW template, could you either attach or introduce them?

I attached a brief one-pager with pilot pricing options and our standard DPA for reference. If it's easier, would appreciate an intro to the person who signs off on pilots (title, email is fine).

Proposed immediate next step: 15 min intro call with the econ buyer + procurement reviewer this week — I can be flexible.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_2027-10-v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@optigrid.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Lewis <ben.lewis@optigrid.io>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 17:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: who signs for budget and security gate?

Thanks, Karthik — good summary. Couple quick notes: 

- Pilot budget lives with our Edge Analytics org; the person who controls discretionary pilot spend is Ben Lewis (Head of Edge Analytics). He’s cc’d here.
- Security review is handled by our InfoSec team; primary contact is security-ops@optigrid.io. They will need the SOC2 summary and a note about data retention policy.
- Procurement: we route small pilots through procurement@optigrid.io. They have a standard PO flow and sometimes ask for a short SOW for pilots.

I’ve attached a procurement checklist that shows the docs they want. I can introduce you to procurement if you prefer a direct intro.

Claire
Head of Product, OptiGrid
claire.zhang@optigrid.io | +1 206-555-8842
[Attachment: OptiGrid_procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Lewis <ben.lewis@optigrid.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@optigrid.io>, procurement@optigrid.io, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: who signs for budget and security gate?

Karthik — welcome, and thanks Claire for the intro. Short version from my side:

- I can sign off on the pilot budget (up to $40k) once we have a one-page SOW and an expected success metric (what you summarized is fine).
- For security, our InfoSec needs SOC2 Type II summary and confirmation that Redwood does not retain raw customer telemetry beyond the stated 30 days.
- Procurement (procurement@optigrid.io) prefers a PO + short SOW; they sometimes ask for the vendor DPA. I’m copying them so they have context.

I attached our procurement SOW template — please populate the pilot period, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and payment terms. If Redwood can provide a draft SOW today, I’ll route it internally and aim to return a PO within 72 hours.

Also: timeline note — I’m on PTO Oct 11–15, so if you can get docs in before then that helps.

Thanks,
Ben Lewis
Head of Edge Analytics, OptiGrid
ben.lewis@optigrid.io | +1 212-555-0999
[Attachment: OptiGrid_SOW_Template.docx (docx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick recap + ask: who signs for budget and security gate?

Karthik — noted. I’ll spin up a 1-page SOW draft today using the OptiGrid template and include the pilot acceptance criteria and token/cost estimates.

Action items I’ll take: 
- Draft SOW (use OptiGrid_SOW_Template.docx): include pilot dates, success metrics, and payment milestone.
- Pull SOC2 Type II summary + short note on our 30-day retention config; attach Redwood_DPA_2027-10-v1.pdf.
- Share SOW and DPA to procurement@optigrid.io and Ben for PO routing.

I’ll loop you once the SOW is ready. Target: by EOD today (10/6) so Ben can route before PTO.

—Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
